records.title: Optimal measurements for the dihedral hidden subgroup problem
records.mechanism: Collective PGM expressed through subset-sum fiber multiplicities.
records.reduction: Fiber preparation connects to measurement implementation.
records.no_go_barrier: Information-theoretic success does not supply efficient fiber processing.
records.proof_technique: Covariance, character orthogonality and multiplicity moments.
records.open_question: Costed native collective implementation without exponential tables.
records.reusable_abstraction: Distinguish success existence from circuit cost.
records.local_application: Vector-group decomposition and random-target pairwise/Holder lower bound are derived locally, not attributed as an exact paper theorem.

records.title: Adaptivity is all you need: Optimal stabilizer learning using just single-copy measurements
records.evidence_read: TheoremII.1, Algorithm1 and computational-difference proof; nullity extension scope.
records.mechanism: Adaptive Clifford changes across repeated copies of a fixed state.
records.reduction: No source-preserving transfer to changing native DCP packets supplied.
records.no_go_barrier: Single-copy measurement does not mean one physical copy total.
records.proof_technique: Computational differences and monotone diagonal stabilizer growth.
records.open_question: A legitimate varying-packet transfer, if one exists.
records.reusable_abstraction: Audit state identity and copy lineage before invoking a learner.
